title: Push notifications - Scenario 21
preconditions_original: Notifications service available and ready for operations
expected_results_original: System correctly handles push notifications scenario
business_context: Validates that the platform can reliably deliver transactional push notifications to end users without service disruption.
functional_intent: Checks that when a push notification is triggered, the notification service queues, sends, and reports delivery status correctly for the configured recipients.
searchable_summary: Test push notification delivery flow to ensure events are queued, sent through the push gateway, and reported as successfully delivered to users.
